column1: # Fleet floors. One clause per line: clause-id <TAB> required value.
# Raising a floor turns every repo below it amber at once; each then clears on
# its own schedule. Never raise a floor and fix a repo in the same PR, and never
# lower one to make a repo green. See docs/ratchet.md.
# A line here is a value some gate reads. The coverage floors live in
# docs/testing.md instead, because those clauses are `pending` and a floor
# sitting in this file for a clause nothing computes reads as enforced.
